Officer's narrative
On arrival at the intersection in League City, Texas, I found a side-impact collision between two passenger vehicles.
Driver 1 was operating the vehicle struck on the driver side and is the claimant in this report. Driver 1 reported a
concussion, with headache and dizziness since the impact, a symptom pattern that fits the forces expected in a crash
of this type. Passenger was seated in the front right seat of Driver 1's vehicle. I confirmed Passenger's presence at
the scene, and Driver 2 also confirmed it. Driver 2 was operating the other vehicle, which entered the intersection as
Driver 1 was proceeding through. Scene photographs confirm the general postiion of both vehicles and the area of
primary impact, but no independent witnesses came forward to describe the sequence. From the scene, it is not clear
whether all of the damage to Driver 1's vehicle resulted from this collision. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
Records show that Driver 1 is named on the policy covering the vehicle involved.
